<https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3e74590/lib/internal/url.js#L687>\n/**\n * Checks if a value has the shape of a WHATWG URL object.\n *\n * Using a symbol or instanceof would not be able to <https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3e74590/lib/internal/url.js#L687>\n/**\n * Checks if a value has the shape of a WHATWG URL object.\n *\n * Using a symbol or instanceof would not be able to <https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3e74590/lib/internal/url.js#L687>\n/**\n * Checks if a value has the shape of a WHATWG URL object.\n *\n * Using a symbol or instanceof would not be able to <https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3e74590/lib/internal/url.js#L687>\n/**\n * Checks if a value has the shape of a WHATWG URL object.\n *\n * Using a symbol or instanceof would not be able to
